## Slack Meeting Notes Distributor

Distribute meeting notes to Slack and email.

**Flow:**
1. Receive notes via webhook
2. Parse attendees into internal/external
3. Post formatted notes to Slack channel
4. Email external attendees if any
5. Archive to Google Sheets

**Webhook payload:**
```json
{
  "title": "Sprint Planning",
  "notes": "Discussed Q2 goals...",
  "channel": "#engineering",
  "attendees": ["U123", "ext@partner.com"],
  "actionItems": [{"task": "...", "owner": "...", "due": "..."}]
}
```
